svg.title: A1: Can early regulation add information about later output?
svg.desc: Original editable cellular hypothesis illustration. Cell geometry, number and scale are qualitative, not observations. Connections distinguish locally labelled proposals, comparisons and chronology. See the owning context for the unchanged full hypothesis and primary/repository evidence.
svg.text: Can early regulation add information about later output?
The regulatory feature is unnamed; current samples do not supply the required linkage
Early regulatory information beyond starting RNA state • independent biological units
Dashed: proposed comparison / readout • icons and counts are qualitative
Prediction is not causation; chromatin heterogeneity alone does not establish competence or fate.
Original authorable vector artwork • complete hypothesis, units and sources remain in the owning context
